## Comparison of key soil properties between irrigated and non-irrigated fields

# Load packages

```{r}
library(lmerTest)
library(lme4)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```


# Import soil property data

```{r}
metadata1 <- read.csv("./Soil_properties/Data/Metadata_Irrigation.manipulative.exper.csv", header = T,row.names = 1)
env1 <- read.csv("./Soil_properties/Data/Vetted_soil_properties.csv", row.names = 1, header = T)
metadata <- metadata1[rownames(metadata1) %in% rownames(env1),]
env2 <- env1[rownames(metadata),]
env <- cbind(metadata, env2)
```

# Plot soil property value in irrigated and non-irrigated fields

```{r}
# Surface moisture
range(env$SM.M10)
tapply(env$SM.M10, env$Irrigation, mean)
p1 <- ggplot(data = env, aes(x = Irrigation, y = SM.M10, fill = Irrigation)) +
geom_violin(linewidth= 0.5, size=0.2, alpha= 0.7) +
geom_boxplot(alpha= 1, width= 0.17, fill= "white") +
scale_fill_manual(values = c("#4169B2", "#BB2BA0","gray")) +
labs(x = "", y = "Suface moisture (m3/m3)") + 
theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 17, colour = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 17, colour = "black"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 17),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 17),
      legend.position = "none") + 
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.2, 0.330))

p1
ggsave("./Soil_properties/Output/Surface moisture.pdf", p1, width = 4.5, height = 5)
```

# Statistical test on the soil properties

```{r}
anova(lmer(SM.M10 ~ Irrigation + (1|State), data = env))
anova(lmer(Silt ~ Irrigation + (1|State), data = env))
anova(lmer(Sand ~ Irrigation + (1|State), data = env))
anova(lmer(pH ~ Irrigation + (1|State), data = env))
anova(lmer(TC ~ Irrigation + (1|State), data = env))
anova(lmer(TN ~ Irrigation + (1|State), data = env))
anova(lmer(CalcNRelease_N ~ Irrigation + (1|State), data = env))
anova(lmer(Biomass ~ Irrigation + (1|State), data = env))
anova(lmer(Fe.Zn_ratio ~ Irrigation + (1|State), data = env))
anova(lmer(NDVI.2021 ~ Irrigation + (1|State), data = env))
anova(lmer(Fe ~ Irrigation + (1|State), data = env))
```
